# A cloud (generated by make_env.py), 3.6 x 1.4 x 1.4 m.
new
material new Cloud --base-color 0.969 1.0 0.682 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.6 --location -1.1 0 0.45
scale 1 0.7 1
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.85 --location -0.2 0 0.75
scale 1 0.7 1
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.7 --location 0.8 0 0.55
scale 1 0.7 1
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.45 --location 1.45 0 0.35
scale 1 0.7 1
apply --scale
material assign Cloud
select all
shade flat
export cloud.glb
